description: Land Acquisition - Meemure, Udadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District - Ambanella, Walapane D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Kumbukgahamulla, Udabaddawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders directing acquiring officers to take possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the land acquisition authority being exercised.
